notes.title: Notice : Pilgrimage of Compassion Stage Difficulty Adjustment Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

Difficulties for Stages LC-PC-11 and LC-PC-14 will be changed with enemy adjustments.

We determined that the Normal difficulty may be presenting too significant a challenge when it comes to defeating the enemies in those stages, even with Identity & E.G.O Level/Upgrade Tier adjustments.

Therefore, we are making adjustments to the Normal difficulty of the Pilgrimage of Compassion to allow for an easier experience when enjoying the story.

※ The Hotfix will be deployed without a separate client update, but please note that additional in-game downloads may occur.


Please continue reading for more information.


[Pilgrimage of Compassion Stage Difficulty Adjustments]
1. Stage LC-PC-11 enemy difficulty will be adjusted.

[In Normal, Hard difficulties both]
▶ Mid-battle Choice Event check requirements will be lowered.

[In Normal difficulty only]
▶ Enemies featured in this Stage will lose 5 levels.
※ Naturally, with this level adjustment, their Offense/Defense Levels and HP will be decreased.


2. Stage LC-PC-14 enemy difficulty will be adjusted.

[In Normal, Hard difficulties both]
▶ Reading priority marker will be added to one of the enemy Passives.
※ Affected Passive : Nethersea Brand Utopia

[In Normal difficulty only]
▶ The enemy will lose Defense Levels.
- Before : Level -0
- After : Level -5

▶ 'Tidal Arc' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Power gain conditional adjusted
- Before : [On Use] For every 5 Nervous Impairment on target, consume 1 Abyssal Vitality to gain Clash Power +1 (max 5)
- After : [On Use] For every 10 Nervous Impairment on target, consume 1 Abyssal Vitality to gain Clash Power +1 (max 2)

(2) Coin 2 effect adjusted
- Before : Unbreakable Coin, [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 2 Nervous Impairment

▶ 'Fierce Currents' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Base Power adjusted
- Before : 4
- After : 3

(2) Coin 2 effect adjusted
- Before : [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 2 Nervous Impairment

▶ 'Undulating Waves' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Power gain conditional adjusted
- Before : [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 3 Nervous Impairment on the main target (max 9)
- After : [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Nervous Impairment on the main target (max 5)

(2) Coin 1 effect adjusted
- Before : [On Hit] Inflict 6 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment


[Hotfix Deployment ETA]
- 09.26(Fri) 16:30(KST)
- There may be a 10-minute margin of error from the ETA.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you.

notes.title: MD Parallel Superposition EXTREME Changes & Update Schedule

Hello, this is Project Moon.

We would like to share some additional information regarding changes and upcoming new content to the Mirror Dungeon Parallel Superposition EXTREME mode, which will be updated Sep. 4th, 2025 12:00 (KST).

Please continue reading for more information.

[ Planned Changes ]
Certain aspects of "Adversity" will be adjusted at a later date.

[ Adversity with Planned Changes ]
Multiplies the amount of E.G.O Resources consumed when using E.G.O Skills

This Adversity's sole purpose was to increase the difficulty within Mirror Dungeons.
However, we realized that this Adversity would affect certain E.G.O Gifts' functions, causing them to work in unintended ways.

Therefore, this Adversity will be disabled for the Sep. 4th update,
and will be added back to the game after its logic is adjusted to affect only the E.G.O Resource consumption multiplication and nothing else.

※ The other Adversities are working as intended.



[ Planned Content ]
After the Parallel Superposition EXTREME Mode release, new bosses will be added to the mode.

[ Content ]
Several powerful enemies whom the manager had clashed with in the past will now spawn as new boss enemies.
Starting from Floor 11, there will be a small chance for them to invade a preexisting dungeon node to activate a battle encounter.

However, as it takes time to customize those boss enemies for the environments of the Mirror Dungeon, and applying all of them to the Mirror Dungeon at the same time could cause delays, we are planning to update the preexisting enemies first with the Sep. 4th update, with the new bosses coming with a future update.

We will share a more detailed information via a notice when the new bosses are updated.


To all users who have been looking forward to fighting the new bosses in the EXTREME mode, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

We will apply these changes and complete the update as soon as possible to provide a better gameplay experience.

[Bug Fixes & Improvements]
▶ Fixed the incorrect description for the E.G.O Gift 'The Unchosen', where the text did not match our intentions
- Before : Whenever an ally is killed, all allies gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn
- After : When an ally is killed, all allies gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn)

※ This issue was caused by failing to update the description to match the E.G.O Gift effect changes that were made in the pre-release phase of the Walpurgis Night event, which caused the outdated version of the description to be applied to the live version of the game.

Normally, our policy is to change the effects to match the texts. However, if we were to change the effects to match the text in this case, it could cause a balancing issue in which ally death could give up to 12 Attack Power Up to all allies, so we intend to change the text instead.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by the incorrect text description.


We are currently investigating these known issues,
and we will fix them as soon as the exact issue is identified.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

or bonuses from the Grace of Stars.
We failed to see this during the early stages of our design, and this issue occurred due to our inadequacies. We will be sure to continue refining ourselves and improving the game.

Hello, this is Project Moon.

- Fix: Added the deselect function and deactivated the "Confirm" button when no Sinner is selected

- Cause: Localization data was not linked to the build
- Fix: Linked the localization data to the build

Our intent in designing Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair was to have an unstable SP character with a high Skill Power ceiling. 
However, we observed that the instability caused much more frustration than we had intended.
This was especially true for situations in which Sinclair could not Clash with the enemies or if the enemies had abilities that could lower their SP.
Basically, the situations in which the player could not control the allies' SP.
In our testing phase, we ran the tests with a SP-healing team that could support his SP loss, so we failed to catch this issue.
This led to this character being far too weak in teams that weren't focused on SP healing, which we intend to address.

- The following SP heal/loss conditions will be adjusted.
Before : Increase by 15 after defeating an enemy whose level was higher than this unit's.
After : Increase by 10 after defeating an enemy whose level was higher than this unit's. Also, it increases by 15 after defeating an enemy regardless of the enemy's level.

notes.notes:
Hello, this is Project Moon.
We would like to inform you about the issues that have been identified after the Jan. 11th Scheduled Update, and our subsequent measures regarding them.

1. An issue where the game freezes in certain Focused Encounters

[Issue Details]
- (Focused Encounter) When an enemy that is scheduled to attack is killed, the game freezes.
(Ambling Pearl, Shock Centipede, Doomsday Calendar, King Trash Crab, Skin Prophet, Become Strong? Genuinely?, Pink Shoes, etc etc)

[Cause]
- In order to optimize, we deleted several unnecessary logs from the game. However, in the process, we mistakenly deleted logs that were still being used by the game as well.

[Solution]
- Corrected the code so that the deleted logs are not used.
- Temporary Solution: For combat encounters with summoned units, kill all summoned units first. Defeat the Boss unit when it's the only remaining enemy in the stage.


2. An issue where using the skip battle function in the Thread & EXP Luxcavations caused UI to glitch

[Issue Details]
- This issue can be reproduced by going straight to the Luxcavations and choosing to skip battle immediately after starting the game. (results screen only displays white images)
- After this issue occurs, the Main UI of the game, such as Window or Drive will not function properly.
- Using the skip battle function after completing other encounters normally does not cause this issue, and the Main UI of the game will function normally.

[Cause]
- This issue occurred because viewing the encounter result screen without a single deployed unit (like in skipped battles) did not properly load the data.
- This is a side effect of programming in The 2nd Walpurgis Night encounter result screen.

[Solution]
- We have corrected the code that caused this issue to occur.

The above two issues require a client build to be corrected.
We will work as fast as we can to correct the issue, prepare the build, and submit it so that you can play our game without these issues.

We will update the game immediately on STEAM,

but iOS and Android require us to submit the build for review first. We will inform you with an additional notice as soon as we pass the review and the new versions are made available to those platforms.

We are also currently investigating the below issues.
We will inform you of the solutions and the subsequent measures regarding them as soon as we identify their causes.
